matches.note: Thirteen tag teams, open invitation, the winners earning a future shot at the PTC Tag Team Champions. Won by Feral — the results page's own line is "WINNERS: Chryste and Callisto Bane" — the DWO tag team registered as the unit `feral`, both of whose members resolve: Chryste to LOW's own entity (the DWO accession, lot 0039, 2026-08-23), Callisto Bane to OSW's. The full field is named on the served card and results pages.

The Extreme Division Cluster-Fuck, open invitation, twenty-seven entrants named on the card, the winner earning a PTC Extreme Championship shot. Won by Kai Shinobi (DWO), who does not resolve to a registered entity. The card page announces the gimmick as "to be decided"; the results page stages it as a Steel Mill Match, which is the stipulation recorded here. TS's own two-man delegation is staged at length: NecroWraith opens the match alone, dropping off a catwalk to take out eleven men in one blow, then fights through the field (Tyrone Grace, Sara Johnson, Chris Wrestling) before reaching the match's own final four, where Iron Lung puts him out with a dragon sleeper. Laguna, his own delegation-mate, turns on him mid-match — "Laguna attacks NecroWraith" — and the two grapple each other at length (NecroWraith has him in a chokehold at one point, "Laguna fights back but slumps down") before Laguna, freed by a Tyrone Grace run-in, is last seen recovering a steel slab as three other men crash into him; the results page loses track of him from there, and no elimination or finish is recorded for him.

The GW title defended on the alliance's own supercard and fought in a traditional square ring rather than GW's own Octagon, which its own commentary remarks on. Camero won it with a superplex DDT: "The winner of this match, and NEW Global Wrestling World Champion!!!, The Canadian Icon Christopher Camero!!!"

matches.stipulation: XWF World Heavyweight Championship, No DQ
matches.note: Billed on the results page as "C.R. v. Limp Bizkit w/ DJ & Raven" and fought under No DQ rules, which the commentary uses to wave off Raven attacking before the bell. Raven and DJ worked it from ringside throughout and the Corporation — La Envidia Mata, DVD and Asesino — ran in on top of them, leaving the champion bleeding through a table before he retained: "The Winner and still XWF World Heavyweight Champion C.R.!!!" Structured 2026-08-23, when the XWF accession made both men resolve.

matches.note: The fifteen-man, invitation-only PTC Global Championship match, fought under timed entries. Won by Donny Diamond (DWO), who does not resolve to a registered entity — the first PTC Global Champion the surviving record can name since Vampir Nosferatu. Fourteen men actually competed: the commentary reports mid-match that Tristan Belmont (LOW) chose not to appear, having gone to the LOW arena for his own match instead, so he takes no fall and is not an elimination entry. Diamond had already beaten Kaiowas for the DWO World Heavyweight Championship earlier the same night.

notes: PTC's own interfed supercard, staged across the member feds of the alliance and billed as "representing over 25 promotions." Ten matches ran; seven are structured here. The three that are not have no entrant who resolves to a registered entity — the FAW World Heavyweight Title match (9th Wonder of Foam retained over Rzarector and Xander in a Tables, Ladders & Chairs match), the Genesis/Ace Masters Special Trash Talk Challenge (Genesis by pinfall), and the PTC Extreme Title match (Maelgrim defeated Terry Woods). The DWO World Heavyweight Title match, seventh on the night, was structured on 2026-08-23 once the DWO accession made Donny Diamond and Kaiowas both resolve; the XWF World Heavyweight Title match, sixth, was structured the same day off the XWF accession, which also resolved the Steel Mill and Tag Cluster fields and five more entrants of the Global Title match. The Global Wrestling title match appears in the results but not on the announced card. TS's own three-man delegation (Samba Tatenaka, Laguna, NecroWraith) was resolved in TS's own tier-3 pass, off this same results page and its own delegation roster. The delegation abbreviated "LOW" throughout this event is Lights Out Wrestling, per the fed link on the event's own Superstars page and the roster overlap with PTC's own separately-served Lights Out Wrestling member profile — not the Lords of Wrestling that PTC's own 2002 channel guide abbreviates the same way. name: Infinite Gauntlet — Round 49 (the qualifier for the vacant title)

date.source: The Round 50 announcement's own date, 26 Sep 2008 (PTC forum post 279062).

notes: Round 49 of PTC's Infinite Gauntlet, first announced on 9 September 2008 as a match for every former champion with the champion defending, and rebuilt on 12 September as an open invitation after the champion vacated the title in the forum that day: any character the entrant owned, 500 words or less, selling why that character deserved the vacant championship, one roleplay posted to the round's thread by the end of 21 September 2008. Six roleplays came in, from Kenny Mercury, Space Condom Monster of Death (the Church of the Unholy's entry), Itachi Kobayoshi, "Exceptional" Dave Hurst, Brian Spaes and King Blueberry (Jared Sykes). The people whose roleplays were judged worthy were to go into a short tournament, Round 50, for the vacant title; the matchups posted on 26 September 2008 list Kenny Mercury, Darth von Doom, Itachi Kobayoshi, Dave Hurst, Brian Spaes and King Blueberry, so Darth von Doom stands in the Round 50 field where Round 49's roleplay field has Space Condom Monster of Death. No placings are posted for this round, so the match names no winner.

name: PTC Tag Team Title three-way, April 2005 — the judges' ruling (no match written)

date.source: The ruling post's own date, 26 Apr 2005 (PTC forum post 147097).

notes: The title three-way booked for April 2005, "Purgatory with a Pinata": Unholy Matrimony against Soul Purpose and the champions, billed Los Muchos Macho Mascadas (the Masked Monkeys), one roleplay each. No federation offered to host it, so no match was ever written and the titles were decided on the judges' scores for the roleplays. The post tabulates three judges. Judge one placed Unholy Matrimony first, Los Muchos Macho Mascadas second and Soul Purpose third. Judge two placed Unholy Matrimony first, Soul Purpose second and Los Muchos Macho Mascadas third. Judge three named only a second place (Hanson) and a third place (Thommy). The final ruling: "Sean is the new Tag Team Champion defeating the others. In second place is Noah Hanson/Fury and in last is Thommy." Unholy Matrimony took the Tag Team Championship from the Masked Monkeys; Soul Purpose (Noah Hanson and Fury) finished second. The post closes with an apology to the competitors "who rped and deserved a written match".
